welcome.headline: 50 Years of Love
welcome.supporting: Celebrating the beautiful journey of M. Buvaneswari.
welcome.message: Some people make a house a home, ordinary moments into memories, and family into everything. Today, we celebrate the woman who has given us all of that and so much more.
welcome.theme: 50 Years of Love, Strength, Sacrifice & Beautiful Memories.
welcome.greetingLine: Fifty years of you. A lifetime of us, loving you back.

age.ending: From your first little steps to fifty beautiful years — every chapter has been precious.

finale.headline: Happy 50th Birthday, Amma!
finale.subline: 50 Years of Beautiful Memories. A Lifetime of Love. Countless Reasons to Celebrate You.
finale.message: We may never be able to give back everything you have given us, but we will spend our lives making sure you always feel how deeply you are loved.
